Method.Description: Calculation method: 'newton', 'gradient', 'levenberg-marquardt', 'fsolve' (needs Optimization Toolbox) or 'dynamic' (virtual bus dynamics)

Tolerance.Description: [pu] Largest P/Q mismatch of a converged solution (every method)

MaxIteration.Description: Maximum number of iterations. 0: automatic (newton 50, gradient 1e6, levenberg-marquardt 100, fsolve 400)

WhenFailed.Description: Behavior if the power flow calculation does not converge

WarmStart.Description: Start from the last power flow solution of the network (false: flat start)
